versions.changelog: v4 Ultimate: 65 named checks (SS-001 to SS-065). SARIF v2.1.0 output, C2 IP blocklist, pre-commit hooks, GitHub Actions CI, known malicious actor DB, 13 exfil endpoints, 14 paste services, macOS attack detection (xattr/Keychain/TMPDIR/osascript), agent config tampering, LLM tool exploitation, punycode domains, process persistence, string evasion, password-protected archives. 16 test cases, 2796 lines, 0.66s scans. Everything Skillvet has plus 18 features it doesn't.

v3 Elite: Campaign detection (ClawHavoc, ClickFix), YARA-style custom rules, auto-quarantine, diff scanning, HTML dark-theme dashboard, reputation grading (A-D), deep string analysis (base64/hex decode), behavioral analysis (staged exfil, download+execute, env harvesting), interactive mode, SBOM generation, ANSI injection detection, pickle attacks, dynamic imports, SSL bypass, symlinks, npm hooks. 2,036 lines, 11 test cases, 0.3s scan time. Zero dependencies.

v2: 9-category threat detection — prompt injection, supply chain attacks, wallet theft, reverse shells, data exfiltration. Smart domain allowlist, SHA-256 tamper detection, JSON/markdown reports, cron watchdog. Built in response to ClawHavoc (386 malicious skills). Zero dependencies.
